description: Path decisions of the 2026-09-23 field sessions replayed through _choose_path (alpha 0.1.9 second pass, item 2). Each decision is the scoreboard as its `path_selected` record printed it (rate, measured, stale, the readings that were still fresh, misses) plus what the record does not carry, rebuilt from the capture: `current` is board.current (set by selected / switch / discovered records -- a trial does not move it); `misses_attempts` is the record's per-SEND miss count times direct_send_attempts (2), since the builds that wrote these counted per send -- the exact rescale alpha 0.1.9's item 4 documented; `last_failure_ts` is the last counted miss (firmware / hop1_abort) charged to the candidate the way the scoreboard charges it, to the path resolved when the result lands; `cooldown_until_ts` is 120 s after a `switch` away from it. `last_seen` is not in the capture: no fresh external evidence is assumed. `ts` is wall-clock seconds and stands in for the monotonic clock.
